css_rules_screen.main: class relative z-10 min-h-dvh border-b border-gray-900 bg-gray-950 shadow-xl shadow-gray-950
css_rules_screen.toc_item: a.blog-aside-link{color:gray-500;filter:drop-shadow(1px 1px 3px #0003);transition 150ms} data-active:text-gray-400 transition-colors 320ms cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1); number span font-mono tabular-nums opacity .5 mr-1; text span data-past:opacity-50 (320ms); strike = svg.rough-annotation (rough-notation) stroke 2px gray-500/50%
css_rules_screen.code_lines: pre code{display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow-x:auto;font-size:13.7px;line-height:22px;scroll-padding:16px;mask-image:var(--scroll-fade-inline) driven by animation-timeline:scroll(self inline), fallback min(12%,40px)} pre code>span{padding-right:16px} first span padding-top 16px, last padding-bottom 16px
css_rules_screen.highlight_line: code span[data-highlighted-line]{background-color:#ca9e6610;border-left:1px solid #ca9e66} number color #ca9e66; margin-right calc(1rem - 2px)
css_rules_screen.code_frame: four span[aria-hidden] dashed 1px gray-700/80: horizontal inset-x -4rem (mobile max(-1.5rem,50%-50dvw)) mask 90deg transparent→15%→85%→transparent; vertical inset-y -3rem (mobile -1rem) mask transparent→35%→65%→transparent
css_rules_screen.copy_button: button absolute top-0.5 right-4 -m-3 p-3 (40x40) text-gray-500 hover:brightness-150 aria-label="Copy code"; icon span animates scale/blur/opacity; no tooltip observed
css_rules_screen.callout: blockquote.blockquote-mask{--border-size:3px;border-radius:.25rem;background:radial-gradient(circle at top left,#0000 0,#0000 16px,color-mix(accent 12%) 16px,color-mix(accent 8%) 90%) top left} :before{width:3px;height:calc(100% - 15px);top:15px;left:0;border-radius:0 0 0 2rem;bg accent} relative my-8 rounded p-4; icon svg 32px at -13px/-13px fill accent 80%; .blockquote-title{color:accent 80%;font-weight:600} lowercase first-letter:capitalize
css_rules_screen.blur_overlay: .blur-overlay fixed z-50 h-[clamp(40px,10vh,160px)] top and bottom; :before backdrop blur(.5px) z1; 6 divs backdrop blur 1/2/4/6/8/12px z2..7 each masked to a 12.5%-stepped band; :after blur(8px) z8 masked 87.5%→100%
css_rules_screen.header: header.fixed.z-50 bottom-[calc(1rem+safe-area)] sm:top-0, transition all 2000ms cubic-bezier(.075,.82,.165,1); hidden state opacity 0 + filter blur(16px)
css_rules_screen.wide_media: [data-pullsher-root]{position:relative;z-index:40;margin-block:32px;xl:width:48rem} > [data-pullsher-stage]{relative left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 xl:w-5xl (1024px)} > [data-pullsher-content]{relative z-50} > surface bg-gray-950 rounded 28px; sibling div fixed inset-0 z-30 with animated backdrop blur (zoom/lightbox overlay)
css_rules_screen.video_player: [data-video-player] rounded 28px bg-gray-950; <video muted playsinline preload=metadata> inside a toggle button; controls bar absolute inset-x-2 bottom-2 z-20, 44px buttons, slider role=group "Video progress"; .blur-overlay h-30 (120px) behind controls
css_rules_screen.permalink: h2 > a[aria-label="permalink to this heading"] "#" font-fancy gray-500 opacity-0 blur(4px) mr-[-1ch] delay 300ms duration 300ms; group-hover/target: opacity 1 blur none pr .5ch duration 150ms
css_rules_screen.link_default: .link-default{color:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 50%,gray-950);text-decoration:underline;transition 150ms} hover filter brightness(150%); favicon img 16px mr .3em -translate-y-px inline-block
css_rules_screen.inline_code: background oklab(.24 ...)/.6, backdrop-filter saturate(1.5), padding 2px 6px, 13.7px/22px Geist Mono, dashed faded side borders
css_rules_screen.footer_social: li.group > a.link-default + span.text-gray-600 xl:text-gray-700 xl:blur-xs(4px) xl:cursor-crosshair duration 300ms; group-hover: blur none, text-gray-600. Below xl (1280px): no blur
